data.body:
Epic close attempted-and-held: 3 children are still open, so this epic stays `in_progress`.

Slice status as of 2026-10-30 10:50 PDT:

- Slice 11 `f7bd-e80c` unequalled-curly-erin — **closed**. Its deletion merged as `50d5a36539d` (Gerrit 3149) and the follow-up comment fix merged as `86ce31117e3` (Gerrit 3153, `LLM-Review +1` and `Verified +1`). Completion verifier PASS, certified at `86ce31117e35e35ac93e31d1aa2e3eadf337b00b`.
- The other 9 slices merged independently; slice 10 closed as a duplicate.

Outcome of the slice programme: the single-pass review demo and the `ticket-quality` reviewer prompt are gone, and the packaged reviewer catalog now holds 5 entries — `code-quality`, `completion-verifier`, `security`, `spec-alignment`, `tests`.

Still open, blocking this epic:

1. `a256-1ae4` chivalrous-consistent-tigermoth — the superseded monolithic story. Its close is refused by the plan-review close gate (`unsigned: no certified plan-review attestation`); it never passed plan review because it was decomposed into the slices. `declare_no_file_impact` is recorded, so only the attestation is missing. Needs a human decision: run `review-plan` on an obsolete plan, or use the human-only `--force=<reason>` break-glass. Details on that ticket.
2. `a018-a2c0` armed-clueless-mouse — "Plan-review attestation: delete confirmed-dead helpers, fold…". Unexpectedly open; not part of the slice programme's landed work.
3. `f5f5-51cd` stubborn-nepheline-eyas — "Warn once on the legacy activate id-list form in .rebar/criteria_routing.json". Unexpectedly open; it records `depends_on a256-1ae4`, so closing a256 would unblock it.

No force override was used anywhere in this session.
